findings.claim: case_figures collects only ReconciliationError per account. Any other error from _figures in another account propagates at once, so an account that fails R3 has its difference and lines dropped and the workspace shows only the other refusal. Nothing is shown, but the R3 report is incomplete.
findings.repro: Two-account case: monkeypatch overrides.categorise so that account 'main' L2 becomes SUPPLIER (fails R3) and account 'savings' has a line with reverses set to a missing id, so metrics.compute raises AmountError at metrics.py:582. GET /api/case gives state 'refused' with the AmountError text, and reconciliation is null, so main's 30025 pence and L2 are not reported. Only a categoriser bug reaches this, as with the R3 trigger itself.

findings.claim: CaseNotReconciled.difference_pence adds signed per-account differences, so opposite differences cancel and the case-level difference_pence in /api/case can be 0, or smaller than either account's, for a case that does not reconcile. The per-account rows and the HTML still give each account's real difference.
findings.repro: Two accounts, one with buckets short of money in by 100 pence and the other over by 100 pence: /api/case reconciliation.difference_pence == 0 and difference == '0.00', while accounts[] shows 100 and -100.
